PHRM 100.description: Scientific concepts and pharmacy practice principles. Role of the pharmacist, patient assessment skills, professional identity, communication skills, and an understanding of legal and ethical responsibilities. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 111.description: Modules and integration activities focusing on: an introduction to infectious diseases; musculoskeletal disorders; dermatology; head, eyes, ears, nose, and throat disorders; and hematology. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 100. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 131.description: Principles of clinical study design, focusing on biostatistical foundations, randomized controlled trials, and systematic review of randomized controlled trials. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 141.description: Current and future roles for pharmacists and controversies in pharmacy practice. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 161.description: Knowledge and skills related to the role and applications of technology in health care. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 171.course_name: Introductory Pharmacy Practice Experience - Outpatient I
PHRM 171.description: Direct patient care and drug distribution activities in an outpatient setting. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 100, PHRM_V 111, PHRM_V 131, PHRM_V 141, PHRM_V 161. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 211.description: Modules and integration activities focusing on respirology and cardiovascular disorders. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. Corequisite: PHRM_V 231. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 212.description: Modules and integration activities focusing on nephrology, endocrinology, and neurology. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 211. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 221.description: Foundations of nutrition, nutrition for healthy individuals through the lifespan, and selected clinical applications of nutrition in pharmacy practice. Prerequisite: PHRM 171.

PHRM 231.description: Principles of screening and diagnostic tests, clinical prediction rules, clinical practice guidelines, conflicts of interest, economic evaluation of therapeutics and medical technologies, harm-benefit analysis, and how to incorporate the best available evidence into practice. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. Corequisite: PHRM_V 211. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 241.description: Current and future roles for pharmacists and controversies in pharmacy practice, focusing on the roles and training opportunities for pharmacists in specialty areas of outpatient and inpatient practice. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 251.description: Practice environment familiarization and skill development in preparation for experiential learning in inpatient and health authority-based settings. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 252.description: Training for authorization to administer injections. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 261.description: Overview of Indigenous health in Canada and the role a pharmacist can have in collaborating with Indigenous communities in providing culturally safe care and healing. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 270.description: Service learning activities with external community partner sites and members. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 171. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 271.course_name: Introductory Pharmacy Practice Experience - Outpatient II
PHRM 271.description: Direct patient care and drug distribution activities in an outpatient setting, building pharmaceutical knowledge and problem-solving ability. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 211, PHRM_V 212, PHRM_V 221, PHRM_V 231, PHRM_V 241, PHRM_V 251, PHRM_V 252, PHRM_V 261, PHRM_V 270. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 272.course_name: Introductory Pharmacy Practice Experience - Inpatient and Health Authority-Based
PHRM 272.description: Direct patient care activities in inpatient and other health authority-based settings, with application of foundational knowledge and skills. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 211, PHRM_V 212, PHRM_V 221, PHRM_V 231, PHRM_V 241, PHRM_V 251, PHRM_V 252, PHRM_V 261, PHRM_V 270. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 302.description: Individual assignments involving library and clinical investigation of specific problems relating to drug utilization and information topics.

PHRM 303.course_name: Directed Studies in Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
PHRM 303.description: Individual assignments involving library and laboratory investigation of problems involved in the development of pharmaceutical dosage forms.

PHRM 304.description: Individual assignments involving library and scholarly inquiry related to pharmacy education.

PHRM 305.description: Individual assignments involving library and laboratory investigation of certain aspects of drug action.

PHRM 306.description: Individual assignments involving library and field work investigations of problems associated with pharmacy practice.

PHRM 307.course_name: Directed Studies in Epidemiology and Health Outcomes
PHRM 307.description: Individual assignments involving scholarly inquiry related to epidemiology or health outcomes.

PHRM 311.description: Modules and integration activities focusing on psychiatry, gastroenterology disorders, and oncology and palliative care. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272.

PHRM 312.description: Modules and integration activities focusing on reproductive health, sexual health, and genitourinary disorders; special infectious diseases; and toxicology. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 311. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 321.description: Providing a consultative service to patients based on patient medical and travel history. Recommending and administering vaccinations according to guidelines. Making recommendations regarding oral medications needed for safe travel. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 322.description: Development and delivery of patient counselling role-playing activities. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271 and PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 323.description: Indigenous health in Canada and the role pharmacists' cultural humility and safety can play when collaborating with other health professionals and Indigenous communities to provide care and healing. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 324.description: Strategies for leveraging opportunities and addressing barriers to effective pharmacist integration into multidisciplinary primary care teams and optimizing patient care. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 325.description: Lectures and discussions of topics on the application of pharmacokinetic principles and the use of therapeutic drug level monitoring in clinical pharmacy practice. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 326.description: Case-based approach to pathophysiology, pharmacology, clinical pharmacokinetics, and pharmacotherapy in nephrology with emphasis on the integration and application of fundamental principles to clinical situations in class. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 327.description: Precision medicine approaches in research and medical practice to mitigate drug toxicity and improve drug efficacy. Equivalency: PHAR_V 421. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 328.course_name: Pharmacology of Drugs of Misuse and Abuse
PHRM 328.description: Biological, pharmacological, and psychological aspects of drugs of misuse and abuse. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 329.description: Leadership skills in preparation for the practice of pharmacy in direct or non-direct patient care settings and contexts. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 330.course_name: Pharmacy Practice in Acute and Critically Ill Patients
PHRM 330.description: Pharmaceutical care concepts for managing acute and critically ill patients. Prerequisite: A combined average of 70% or higher in PHRM_V 211 and PHRM_V 212, and all of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 331.description: The historical and contemporary contexts of 2SLGBTQ+ health, the role of pharmacists, and select therapeutic topics related to 2SLGBTQ+ health. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 332.course_name: Practical Applications of Pharmacoepidemiology & Health Economics
PHRM 332.description: Principles and methods of collecting epidemiological and economic evidence used to assess the value of pharmaceuticals and services provided by pharmacists. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 333.description: Common oncological diseases and their drug treatment. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 334.course_name: Supporting Patients with Substance Use Disorders
PHRM 334.description: Substance use disorders and their treatment; the pharmacist's role in working with individuals who have a substance use disorder. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 340.description: Basic mechanisms and the clinical management of acute and chronic pain. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 341.description: Current and potential roles for pharmacists, and contemporary issues in pharmacy practice. Focus on the role of pharmacists as patient educators, researchers and collaborators in interprofessional teams. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 346.description: Current issues in obesity and diabetes from pathophysiology to patient care, with a focus on healthcare quality improvement, patient safety, and optimizing outcomes. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. Equivalency: PHAR_V 546. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 351.description: Application of management and leadership principles and skills to pharmacy operations. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 271, PHRM_V 272. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 371.course_name: Outpatient I Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience
PHRM 371.description: Direct patient care activities in an outpatient setting, with increasing diversity of patient care situations. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 311, PHRM_V 312, PHRM_V 341, PHRM_V 351. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 441.course_name: Seminar: Advanced Topics in Pharmacy Practice
PHRM 441.description: Pharmacists in practice, emerging pharmacy practice issues and pharmacists as preceptors. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 371. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 450.description: Seminar course about current and potential roles for pharmacists. Students will also deliver an individual and a group seminar. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 451.description: Principles of clinical study design, focusing on randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, epidemiologic studies (cohort, case-control), pharmacoeconomic analyses, clinical prediction rules, and guidelines. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 452.description: Principles and practices of patient assessment, applied to the monitoring of drug efficacy and toxicity. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 453.description: Pharmacokinetic monitoring of drug therapy in common clinical situations with foundations for application to other drugs. Pharmacogenomics and personalized medicine principles and applications to practice. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 454.description: Values, concepts, issues and responsibilities of individuals exercising leadership and management roles in pharmacy practice and health care settings. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 461.description: Therapeutic foundations. Pass/Fail. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 462.description: Respirology, dermatology, and ears, eyes, nose, and throat. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 463.description: Cardiovascular disorders. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 464.description: Infectious diseases. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 465.description: Neurology and psychiatry. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 466.description: Gastroenterology and musculoskeletal disorders. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 467.description: Genitourinary disorders, reproductive health, endocrinology, and nephrology. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 468.description: Oncology, hematology, and toxicology. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 469.description: Acute and critical care of nephrology, neurology, cardiovascular disorders, gastroenterology, infectious diseases, and respirology. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 471.course_name: Outpatient II Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience
PHRM 471.description: Direct patient care activities in an outpatient setting, with increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in a wide range of therapeutic areas. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 371. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 472.course_name: Inpatient and Health Authority-Based Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience
PHRM 472.description: Direct patient care activities in inpatient and other health authority based-settings, with increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in a wide range of therapeutic areas. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 371. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 473.description: Diverse pharmacy practice experiences in various pharmacy practice, research, health policy, education, and other settings. Placement options will vary from year to year depending on practicum site availability. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 371. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 481.description: Builds on the foundation of patient care and management learning with knowledge about healthcare system improvement. Focuses on principles of quality measurement and quality improvement in health. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 371. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 491.description: Application of integrated problem-solving skills to resolve increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in a variety of outpatient settings. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 451, PHRM_V 452, PHRM_V 453, PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 492.course_name: Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience - Inpatient and Health Authority-Based
PHRM 492.description: Application of integrated problem-solving skills to resolve increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in a variety of inpatient and/or health authority-based settings. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 451, PHRM_V 452, PHRM_V 453, PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 493.course_name: Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience - Specialized Outpatient
PHRM 493.description: Application of integrated problem-solving skills to resolve increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in a variety of specialized outpatient settings. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 451, PHRM_V 452, PHRM_V 453, PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 494.course_name: Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience - Ambulatory/Primary Care
PHRM 494.description: Application of integrated problem-solving skills to resolve increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in a variety of ambulatory or primary care settings. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 451, PHRM_V 452, PHRM_V 453, PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 495.course_name: Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience - Selected Direct Patient Care
PHRM 495.description: Application of integrated problem-solving skills to resolve increasingly complex drug-therapy problems in outpatient or inpatient settings. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 451, PHRM_V 452, PHRM_V 453, PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 496.course_name: Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience - Selected Direct Patient Care or Non-Direct Patient Care
PHRM 496.description: Options available in such domains as patient care (various settings), research, health policy, education, and others. The available placement options will vary from year to year depending on site/practice educator availability. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: All of PHRM_V 451, PHRM_V 452, PHRM_V 453, PHRM_V 461. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 499.description: Assessment of skills in the clinical problem-solving process. Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: Successful completion of all other coursework. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 520.description: This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 521.description: Corequisite: PHRM_V 520. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 522.description: Corequisite: PHRM_V 520. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 521. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

PHRM 523.description: Corequisite: PHRM_V 520. Prerequisite: PHRM_V 522. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
